title: Split runtime.ts
goal: runtime.ts becomes modules by responsibility with no behaviour change
acceptance: Each new module under 600 lines where the boundary allows; existing tests pass unchanged; imports updated
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A move that would change behaviour or a public export goes to a fresh-context design review

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 at agent speed: mechanical moves with unchanged tests. Not a measurement.
